description: This file defines the SubPanelTiles class, which manages the rendering and behavior of subpanel tiles in the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM user interface. It handles tab management, subpanel display logic, and interactions with subpanel data sources, including generating HTML output for subpanels.

classes.name: SubPanelTiles
classes.description: A class that manages the display, tab handling, and interaction logic for subpanels within SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM, supporting dynamic content loading, tab switching, and button rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SubPanelTiles object with focus context, layout keys, and definitions.

methods.name: getSelectedGroup
methods.description: Determines and returns the currently selected subpanel tab group based on user preferences, request parameters, and session data.

methods.name: getTabs
methods.description: Retrieves and optionally displays the list of subpanel tabs available within the selected group, considering user preferences and configurations.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the entire subpanel tiles UI, including tabs, subpanel content, and controls, based on current context and user settings.

methods.name: getLayoutManager
methods.description: Returns an instance of the layout manager, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: get_buttons
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for action buttons associated with a given subpanel, including action menus.

methods.name: getCheckbox
methods.description: Returns HTML for a checkbox linked to a subpanel, optionally including a checkbox template.
